sources.title: AnnotateIt/rfdetr-seg-nano-coco-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An independent, unofficial FP32 ONNX conversion of Roboflow's RF-DETR Seg Nano pretrained checkpoint, produced and validated for AnnotateIt 's local, in-browser auto-annotation. Exported with the officialrfdetr exporter — not a re-implementation.
